requirement.description: The JobDefinition class incorrectly validates Tags parameter, rejecting valid Tags instances while allowing invalid dict/string values. The validation logic in __setattr__ method fails to properly distinguish between valid Tags instances and invalid types.
requirement.contract: The Tags property of JobDefinition should accept Tags instances, AWSHelperFn instances, and reject plain dicts and strings. When a Tags instance is passed, it should be accepted without raising TypeError.
